baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence joins بَخِلَ to the reflexive claim ٱسْتَغْنَىٰ.
baseline_models.mechanism: A possession that ought to pass outward is held inside, while need itself is disavowed. Withholding and self-sufficiency therefore form one closure mechanism rather than two unrelated defects, although the focus alone leaves open whether felt independence licenses retention or retention manufactures felt independence.

activation_trace.role: Withholding possessions from an outlet where they should not be withheld supplies the closed material boundary.
Wealth or reduced need supplies the inward claim that makes the closed boundary appear sufficient.

changed_reading.before: A person happens to be both miserly and wealthy.
changed_reading.after: A person closes what should circulate and interprets that closure as exemption from need.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The branch of غ ن ي in ٱسْتَغْنَىٰ that means sufficing, availing, or standing in for another element.
baseline_models.mechanism: The retained possession is not merely accumulated; it is appointed as a substitute for whatever relation, recipient, or support the subject declines. بخل secures the proxy by preventing its departure, and استغناء names confidence that the proxy can stand in for what has been excluded.

activation_trace.role: Wrongful retention keeps the would-be substitute under the subject's control.
Sufficing and standing in for something supplies the proxy relation assigned to the retained asset.

changed_reading.before: He keeps wealth because he already has enough.
changed_reading.after: He keeps a possession in place so that it can impersonate the relations and supports he refuses to need.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening alternation of covering and disclosure turns self-sufficiency from a transparent condition into a possibly occluding presentation. Withholding seals the dependency inside; the claim of no need is the cover whose adequacy remains exposed to a later unveiling.

activation_trace.role: Withholding from a rightful outlet supplies the sealed interior whose dependencies can be hidden.
Claimed wealth or needlessness supplies the content presented as complete.
A cover rising over and concealing a thing supplies the occluding function assigned to the sufficiency claim.
Uncovering and appearance supply the counter-operation that can expose the dependency retained beneath the claim.

structural_cues: 92:1 and 92:2 place covering and disclosure in immediate alternation before the human contrast.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies cover, disclosure, withholding, and self-sufficiency; I supply the epistemic arrow that the last can function as the first. A live alternative is that the cosmic alternation marks contrast without diagnosing concealment.

changed_reading.before: Self-sufficiency is a settled fact accompanying stinginess.
changed_reading.after: Self-sufficiency may be the covering performance by which stinginess keeps an unacknowledged dependency out of view.

context_deltas.mechanism: Measured creation is displayed through differentiated counterparts. Against that field, استغناء can be heard not only as financial independence but as an attempted exemption from constitutive relation, while بخل is the practical refusal to let anything cross between self and counterpart.

activation_trace.role: Withholding what should reach another supplies the enacted refusal of relation.
Reduced or absent need supplies the claimed exemption from dependence.
Measured formation supplies an ordered field in which difference is constituted rather than self-originating.
The male counterpart supplies one side of an explicitly differentiated pair.
The female counterpart supplies the other side, making isolated completeness less natural as a reading of the world.

structural_cues: 92:3 coordinates the two counterparts under one act of creation rather than presenting either alone.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies measured creation and paired differentiation; I infer that the pair activates relational dependence in the focus claim. The live alternative is that the pair is only a taxonomic contrast and says nothing about human sufficiency.

changed_reading.before: An individual judges that personal resources remove personal need.
changed_reading.after: An individual attempts to opt out of relation inside a created order presented through coordinated difference.

context_deltas.mechanism: The mirrored sequences bind allocation to a forecast about the good and then to increasing ease of motion. Giving accompanies making the good credible and a lightened route; withholding and self-sufficiency accompany discrediting it and a route that twists into difficulty. بخل thus becomes an enacted prediction that release will not be made good, and repeated action makes that prediction easier to inhabit.

activation_trace.role: Wrongful withholding supplies the allocation decision whose implicit forecast is being reconstructed.
Self-sufficiency supplies the internal rationale that retained stock is enough without an outward return.
Handing something over supplies the opposite allocation against which focus withholding becomes legible.
Making a promise or action real supplies the positive expectation that can support release.
Lightness and compliant movement supply the low-friction trajectory paired with the giving sequence.
Assigning a thing to falsehood supplies the rejected forecast paired with withholding.
The repeated lightening of motion supplies path dependence even when the destination is adverse.
Twisting, opposition, and induced difficulty supply the shape of the path made easier to follow.

structural_cues: 92:5-7 and 92:8-10 are matching three-step constructions: allocation, valuation, then facilitation.
The same facilitation verb appears on both routes, so ease describes entrenchment as well as a pleasant outcome.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies mirrored allocation, verification or denial, and facilitated routes; I infer that a belief about return directs allocation and that practice then hardens the belief. A live alternative reverses either arrow: conduct may produce denial, and facilitation may be imposed outcome rather than habit.

changed_reading.before: Withholding is a static moral trait backed by a static feeling of enoughness.
changed_reading.after: Withholding is a wager against the good whose repetition lowers friction toward an increasingly constricted route.

context_deltas.mechanism: The return of غ ن ي under negation tests the focus claim in its availing sense. The retained wealth has been treated as a stand-in; at the moment of falling it cannot stand in for the person, so the focus self-sufficiency becomes proleptic irony rather than a durable state.

activation_trace.role: Withholding keeps the asset available as the subject's chosen reserve and proxy.
Sufficing or standing in for another supplies the precise proxy claim made in the focus.
The same availing function returns under explicit negation, supplying the failed test of the proxy.
Accumulated wealth identifies the retained stock asked to perform the availing function.
A fall into ruin supplies the boundary condition at which the substitute ceases to work.

structural_cues: 92:11 repeats the focus root غ ن ي, negates its efficacy, names wealth, and ends with a fall.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies retained wealth, negated availing, and falling; I infer that the focus actor relied on wealth as a proxy for support or survival. The live alternative is that focus self-sufficiency is broader than money and is only secondarily narrowed by 92:11.

changed_reading.before: The person feels no need because wealth is present.
changed_reading.after: The person has appointed wealth to answer in his place, but the text immediately stages the condition under which that proxy cannot answer.

context_deltas.mechanism: Guidance supplies direction, while the later and the first stretch evaluation across the whole temporal arc and toward an outcome. Against that arc, بخل plus استغناء looks like horizon compression: present stock is treated as terminally sufficient, so deferred direction and consequence are discounted.

activation_trace.role: Present retention supplies the locally certain gain privileged by the compressed horizon.
Current enoughness supplies the claim that no later orientation or provision is needed.
Gentle indication toward a road or truth supplies direction beyond the actor's present inventory.
Deferral to a later time supplies the future interval excluded by presentist sufficiency.
Return to an eventual outcome supplies the terminal reckoning that current retention cannot define.

structural_cues: 92:12 assigns guidance beyond the isolated subject, and 92:13 coordinates the later and the first in one ownership claim.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies direction, delay, beginning, and outcome; I infer a temporal error inside the focus claim, namely treating present possession as the whole horizon. A live alternative is that 92:12-13 assert sovereignty without explaining the psychology of withholding.

changed_reading.after: The focus actor mistakes the present inventory for the terminal horizon and therefore withholds against a future he has edited out.

context_deltas.mechanism: The warning sequence distinguishes turning away from actually being placed at a safe distance. استغناء can therefore be read as a self-made shield: retained means are expected to remove exposure, but withdrawal only changes orientation; effective separation and protection arise through a different relation.

activation_trace.role: Retained possession supplies the material from which the actor tries to make a private shield.
A thing's capacity to suffice or spare another supplies the expected protective function of the shield.
A warning that awakens caution supplies explicit exposure to danger rather than assumed immunity.
Kindled fire supplies the harmful field from which safe distance would have to be real.
Turning the back and withdrawing supplies orientation away from danger without guaranteeing distance from it.
Being removed, kept apart, or made distant supplies actual separation rather than a posture of withdrawal.
Repelling harm by protection supplies the successful function that retained wealth only pretends to perform.

structural_cues: 92:16 predicates denial and turning away of the exposed subject, whereas 92:17 uses passive removal for the protected subject.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies warning, exposure, withdrawal, separation, and protection; I infer that focus self-sufficiency is an attempted self-shield that confuses turning away with being safe. A live alternative is that these context actions describe consequences only and do not expose the focus actor's intended mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The actor keeps resources because he believes they are enough.
changed_reading.after: The actor tries to manufacture immunity from retained resources, but the later spatial grammar separates self-withdrawal from effective protection.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later subject gives his own wealth and undergoes reflexive growth or purification. This reverses the conservation logic of بخل: transfer is not depletion of the self but a means or manifestation of its increase, while retention preserves the object at the cost of arresting the holder.

activation_trace.role: Keeping possessions from their due outlet supplies the conservation strategy that the later sequence reverses.
Possessive enoughness supplies the mistaken equation between keeping the asset and preserving the self.
Giving and conveying supplies the outward transfer that appears to reduce the inventory.
Acquired or abundant wealth identifies the very substance released rather than an abstract kindness.
Growth and increase supply the counterintuitive gain occurring on the giver's side of the transfer.
Purification and soundness supply a second reflexive transformation enabled or displayed by release.

structural_cues: 92:18 places giving, personal wealth, and a reflexive transformation in a single relative clause.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies giving one's wealth and reflexive growth or purification; I infer that release causes or constitutes transformation of the giver. The live alternative is evidential: giving may reveal an already purified state rather than produce it.

changed_reading.before: Withholding conserves the self by preventing loss of its wealth.
changed_reading.after: Withholding conserves the object while stunting the holder; release is the apparent loss through which the giver grows or becomes sound.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later gift is detached from a human favor awaiting settlement and redirected toward a sought end. This activates a transactional reading of focus closure: بخل releases nothing without an equivalent entry, while استغناء seeks a balance sheet on which no unpriced dependence remains. The counter-model gives without making the recipient a debtor or a prior benefactor a creditor.

activation_trace.role: Wrongful withholding supplies the refusal to release value without a balancing claim.
Sufficing or replacing supplies the closed ledger's demand that every relation be made equivalent and dispensable.
Totalizing negation excludes any human party from occupying the creditor position.
A favor or good condition supplies the value that might otherwise create a reciprocal claim.
Collecting and settling a debt supplies the bilateral accounting operation explicitly excluded from the gift.
Seeking a thing supplies a motive that directs the transfer beyond repayment.
Direction and orientation supply the non-bilateral endpoint toward which the released value is aimed.

structural_cues: 92:19 negates a favor being repaid, and 92:20 supplies an exceptive motive instead.
The recipient of wealth is not installed as the final endpoint of the giver's accounting.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies negated debt settlement, an alternative seeking, and a direction; I infer that the focus pair can encode insistence on closed equivalence and freedom from unpriced obligation. A live alternative is narrower: the later verses exclude one repayment motive without defining all withholding as ledger behavior.

changed_reading.before: The miser simply dislikes parting with possessions.
changed_reading.after: The miser permits no uncompensated passage and calls a fully settled human ledger self-sufficiency; the counter-gift leaves that bilateral ledger altogether.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus actor produces present needlessness by retaining, whereas the closing actor is promised future satisfaction after release. استغناء and رضا become rival temporal forms of enoughness: one is seized in advance by closure, the other arrives after exposure to loss and is compatible with acceptance rather than self-exemption.

activation_trace.role: Retention supplies the immediate technique for forcing an experience of enoughness.
Claimed absence of need supplies the premature satisfaction secured in the present.
Contentment opposed to discontent supplies the later state that does not require denial of need.
Acceptance as the contrary of discontent independently preserves the closing state's receptive rather than self-sealing quality.

strongest_changes: The repeated غ ن ي in 92:11 converts self-sufficiency into a directly tested and failed proxy: retained wealth cannot stand in for the falling subject.
The mirrored sequences of 92:5-10 turn withholding into an enacted forecast against the good and a path whose friction decreases through repetition.
Giving one's wealth followed by reflexive growth in 92:18 reverses conservation logic: retention preserves the object while potentially arresting the holder.
92:19-21 exposes two further closures in the focus: a bilateral ledger that rejects uncompensated passage and a satisfaction forced prematurely rather than received after release.
summary.what_was_special: The focus root غ ن ي remained polyphonic instead of collapsing into wealth: it generated needlessness, availing substitution, vocal self-persuasion, and settled habitation. Context then activated distinct cover-and-disclosure, relational, temporal, protective, hydraulic, accounting, and affective mechanisms without forcing them into one final interpretation.
remaining_uncertainties: The causal arrow between withholding and denial remains reversible: disbelief may cause retention, or practiced retention may require disbelief.
92:11 strongly financializes استغناء, but the focus claim may still exceed wealth and include social, epistemic, or existential independence.
The growth or purification in 92:18 may be caused by giving, constituted by it, or merely evidenced through it.
The vocal, hydraulic, drift, and dwelling models are live analogies supported by packet branches, but their lexical distance requires explicit downstream containment.

reader_b.activated_readings_md:
1. **Withholding plus claimed self-sufficiency.** Evidence: `ب خ ل` B001 (stingy withholding), `غ ن ي` B001 (wealth/self-sufficiency). Structural cue: this exactly reverses 92:5’s giving/guarding. Mechanism: the person protects possessions by imagining no need. Abductive move: I infer that self-sufficiency is the inner story that makes withholding coherent. Reading change: miserliness is not just behavior; it rests on a false anthropology of independence.

2. **Sufficing turned into refusal of substitute care.** Evidence: `غ ن ي` B002 (sufficing/availing/replacing), activated by 92:11 “his wealth will not avail” and `ج ز ي` B002 in 92:19 (standing in/sufficing). Structural cue: the root returns negatively in 92:11. Mechanism: the one who declares himself sufficient discovers that his substitute cannot stand in for him. Abductive move: I infer irony from repetition: what he sought as sufficiency becomes non-availing. Reading change: “استغنى” foreshadows collapse of the very sufficiency claimed.

3. **Dwelling and settledness as attachment.** Evidence: `غ ن ي` B004 (settled dwelling/former habitations), activated by 92:11 falling and 92:13 first/last ownership. Structural cue: after self-sufficiency comes loss of support. Mechanism: imagined settled possession is destabilized by temporal ownership belonging to God. Abductive move: I infer that “being at home in wealth” becomes a trap when the end arrives. Reading change: the ayah can imply settled complacency, not merely rich independence.
reader_b.retrospective_surprises_md: 92:20-21 supplied the positive replacement for the negated ledger: after no human favor is being repaid, only face-seeking remains, and it ends in رضى. That made this ayah less a disclaimer and more the clearing of the social field for divine relation.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **A closed circuit of possession and imagined needlessness.** `بَخِلَ` has the packet’s single branch `ب خ ل:B001` (withholding possessions where they should not be withheld), and `ٱسْتَغْنَىٰ` anchors `غ ن ي:B001` (wealth and self-sufficiency). Their coordination reverses 92:5: outward transfer is replaced by retention, and protective caution by a claim of reduced need. The abductive move is that withholding and imagined independence reinforce one another as a closed circuit; grammar supplies association, not mutual causation. The ayah reads as a self-sealing economy rather than two unrelated faults.

2. **Self-sufficiency exposed as a failed functional claim.** The later `يُغْنِى` in 92:11 activates `غ ن ي:B002` (sufficing, availing, or standing in): the same root tests whether possessed wealth can actually perform the sufficiency claimed here. Its explicit failure, after facilitation toward hardship in 92:10, retrospectively corrects `ٱسْتَغْنَىٰ` from achieved status to an assumption awaiting trial. The packet supplies the lexical repetition and negation; the conclusion that 92:11 is the test of 92:8 is abductive. The fixed ayah therefore contains an unstable claim, not a secure condition.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 92:11 was decisive: it repeats `غ ن ي` in the availing branch `B002` and explicitly negates the function claimed here. That later test changed `ٱسْتَغْنَىٰ` from a settled achievement into a self-description whose supporting asset fails at the critical moment.

inter_ayah_rows.note: Boasting of greater wealth and children while expecting immunity closely mirrors claimed self-sufficiency.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Wealth and children do not create nearness, directly limiting their use as grounds for security.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Provision is expanded and restricted by God, shifting sufficiency from self-possession to divine gift.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Refusal to feed when asked exposes withholding through a claim that divine provision excuses it.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: God's freedom from need contrasts with the human claim of needing no one.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Unbounded provision is linked with transgression, qualifying abundance as a basis for self-assurance.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: A recognized share in wealth makes private retention answerable to the needy and deprived.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Humans are successors over entrusted wealth, directly resisting possessive independence.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Rivalry in wealth and children names the worldly inflation that can feed self-sufficient pride.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Wealth and children cannot avail against God, a direct parallel to the focus's false security.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Circulation prevents wealth from remaining among the rich, directly countering hoarding.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Success is tied to protection from the soul's avarice, naming the inner opposite of 92:8.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Wealth and children can distract from remembrance, identifying a concrete cost of abundance.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: The call to spend before death links withheld provision to the irreversible loss of opportunity.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Wealth and children are a trial, not proof of independent security.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Protection from avarice is made the condition of success, directly interpreting the moral danger.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Spending according to capacity makes provision a responsibility rather than a basis for withdrawal.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Amassing and enclosing wealth presents the acquisitive behavior paired with the negative human type.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: A fixed recognized share in wealth is the institutional opposite to withholding.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: The needy and deprived are the recipients of that share, specifying whom miserliness excludes.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: The desire for still more after abundance captures an escalatory form of never-enough self-regard.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Giving food despite personal attachment supplies a concrete counter-practice to miserliness.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Intense love of wealth names the attachment that can generate withholding and self-sufficiency.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: The difficult ascent frames costly generosity as the alternative moral route.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Feeding in famine makes the generous route concrete where private retention is most tempting.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Intense attachment to wealth identifies the affective root that supports the focus disposition.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Rivalry in accumulation supplies a broader social form of self-sufficient abundance.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Accumulating and counting wealth depicts possession treated as durable self-security.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Failure to urge feeding the poor gives a social consequence of a closed relation to provision.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Withholding even small assistance is a concise everyday expression of the miserly stance.

identity_judgment.rationale: Dal çerçevesi, eldeki varlıkları alıkoymanın haklı olmadığı bir durumda onları verilmesi gereken kişi ya da amaçtan esirgeme çekirdeğini doğru biçimde yansıtır. Kişinin kendi varlıklarına ve başkasına ait varlıklara ilişkin kullanımlar, kişi nitelemeleri ve tek bir esirgeme olayı bu çekirdeğe bağlı alt ayrımlardır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Haklı bir nedenle elde tutma bu anlamın dışında kalır; kavramı belirleyen, varlığı vermemenin haksız bir esirgeme oluşturmasıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım ortak anlam çekirdeğini verir; kişi nitelemeleri, tek olay anlatımı ve kişinin kendi ya da başkasının varlıklarına bağlı kullanımlar ayrı yüzler olarak korunur ve tek başlarına yalın çekirdeğe genellenmez.

concept_map.definition: Kişinin, alıkonması haklı olmayan eldeki varlıkları verilmesi gereken kişi ya da amaçtan esirgemesidir. Bu tutum kişinin kendi varlıklarına veya başkasına ait varlıklara yönelik olabilir.

facets.statement: Eldeki varlıkları, alıkonmaları haklı olmadığı halde verilmesi gereken kişi ya da amaçtan esirgeme.
Esirgeme kişinin kendi varlıklarına ilişkin olabilir.
Esirgeyici tutum başkasına ait varlıklar üzerinde de gösterilebilir.
Kavram, yerleşik bir kişi özelliğinin yanı sıra tek bir esirgeme olayını da anlatabilir.

Bu anlam kişinin kendi varlıklarına veya başkasına ait varlıklara yöneltilebilir; ayrıca davranış, bunu yapan kişi ve tek bir olay ayrı dilsel biçimlerle anlatılır.
